title: Distributed Joke System
description: Node.js microservices route submissions through RabbitMQ to an Auth0-protected moderation UI. Approved jokes are stored in MySQL and served through Kong; the stack runs locally in Docker.

title: Rentigo
description: A team-built rental property management system using PHP and MySQL. I contributed tenant-facing property search, booking and lease workflows, rent payment tracking, and maintenance issue views.

title: Becute Dreams Luxe
description: A frontend storefront demo for a sticker boutique, with product browsing, filters, detail pages, and a cart saved in local storage. Checkout and account pages demonstrate the interface without payment or authentication backends.

title: smart home monitoring control
description: An Expo and React Native app for device control, energy tracking, schedules, and security views. Supabase syncs device state with a companion web-based hardware simulator.
